mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.code, t.version, t.title, t.content_url, t.is_required, t.seq, t.effective_at, t.created_at FROM terms t WHERE t.effective_at <= #{asOf} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM terms newer WHERE newer.code = t.code AND newer.effective_at <= #{asOf} AND (newer.effective_at > t.effective_at OR (newer.effective_at = t.effective_at AND newer.id > t.id)) ) ORDER BY t.seq, t.id
